answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities by selling 100 slots per epoch. The network opens an admission pulse each epoch and ranks sealed bids; the top 100 win an identity, losers are refunded. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid others over ten epochs, paying at least 80,000 credits, while its own bids push prices higher. An honest agent pays 80 once, and that bid is the ember of a reputation. Losing bids drain away like water through karst.
